displayName: Recipe: daily spend ceiling or daily cap reached

documentation.content: A reservation was refused today at the daily model-spend ceiling (`spend_threshold` with `percent` 100: `GENERATION_DISABLED` for new recipes until worst cases in flight settle or the UTC day ends) or at the daily recipe cap (`daily_cap_reached`: `DAILY_CAP` until the UTC day ends). Each is logged once per UTC day. Buyers cannot generate meanwhile. If free recipes are being farmed, lower `config/runtime.welcome.perDay` or set `welcome.recipes` to 0. See functions/README.md, "Alerts" and "Welcome grant".
